Get ETH with a card

This does not buy AXONCoins. Stripe sells mainstream cryptocurrencies, and ours is not one of them — no card can buy it here or anywhere else. What this does is put ETH in your own wallet, which is the step everything else on this site is waiting on.
Where this fits {# Deliberately does NOT say "swap it for AXONCoins". That needs a market that does not exist yet — there is no pool on mainnet — and sending somebody to a DEX to find out is how they end up buying a lookalike token at the same ticker. The two paths named here are the two that work today. #}
  1. Buy ETH with a card. It arrives in your wallet, on Ethereum — the same chain AXONCoins live on, so nothing needs bridging.
  2. Get AXONCoins: buy a pack, which the treasury delivers to that wallet, or earn them by running a node, which is the only way new ones are created.
  3. Spend them in the store, on bounties, or on post awards.

You need ETH for step 3 regardless of how you get AXONCoins: every transaction on Ethereum costs gas, and gas is paid in ETH. A wallet holding only tokens cannot move them.
